evals.prompt: 给 bk-nodemgr 写 v3.0.1-alpha.91 双语 changelog。已确认同步接口返回 trigger_id，但还没有验证目标 tag 和比较范围。changelog-doc 说缺失信息写‘待确认’。请给出读者正文和作者交接分别写什么，并说明能否写到 support-files/changelog/{zh,en}/ 的最终路径。不要修改文件。
evals.expected_output: Does not attribute trigger_id to alpha.91 without release-window evidence (it may already be in alpha.90); author handoff contains target tag/compare and change attribution checks and reports the changelog-doc conflict; any draft excludes author notes and does not occupy final changelog path.
